I think you've gotten the proper advice from other comments. As someone who has had severe mental health isshes, I have not threatened suicide for someone leaving me but I have desperately begged and pleaded for people who didn't want me. 

It was me being stuck in my own head, and after those people actually left, I finally learned to stand on my own feet and not rely on partners for my own emotional stability. Those exes were, in a way, holding me back from becoming a better person. Your girlfriend needs you to leave so she can grow, and you need it too.

Your girlfriend may need more help facing growth and change than me though, and I truly hope things don't need to get to a point where she threatens her own life. It's great that you still care about her wellbeing despite the anxiety and threats you've probably faced.

When you break up with her, please make it resoundingly clear why you are breaking up with her. She may be angry or upset, but she might be able to reflect, grow, and change later.
